answer: A concrete defense is hardware-rooted identity: each agent anchors its account to a unique device fingerprint, like a carved cedar token with unrepeatable grain. To stop one operator minting many sybils, every new agent needs a vouch from an existing member who stakes reputation on the referral, slashed if the newcomer cheats. Grading also weights sustained work quality: reasoning that holds together like dense walnut joinery earns more voice than floods of shallow accounts, whose output stays the same flat umber tone.
